manifest.name: Fabel
manifest.description: Stream audiobooks from a Norwegian Fabel subscription (unofficial community provider).

phone.title: Fabel login
phone.description: Sign in with the same Norwegian mobile number as in the Fabel app. You must accept Fabel's terms before we request an SMS code. Only existing accounts are supported.

otp.title: SMS code
otp.description: Enter the one-time code you received by SMS.

profile.title: Listening profile
profile.description: Choose which Fabel profile to use (sent as x-profile-id).

phone_number.label: Mobile number
phone_number.description: Norwegian mobile number used in the Fabel app (8 digits or +47...).

accept_terms.label: I accept Fabel's terms and privacy policy
accept_terms.description: Review Fabel's [terms](https://fabel.no/vilkar) and [privacy policy](https://fabel.no/personvern) before continuing. Only sends an SMS code to an existing Fabel subscription — no new account is created.

otp_code.label: SMS code
otp_code.description: One-time verification code received by SMS.

profile_id.label: Listening profile
profile_id.description: Sent in the x-profile-id header for streams and library requests.

fabel_allowance.label: Listening time this period: {0}h {1}m used · {2}h {3}m remaining ({4}, max {5} concurrent streams).

fabel_allowance_unavailable.label: Listening time: currently unavailable (reopen settings to retry).

errors.accept_terms: Accept Fabel's terms and privacy policy to continue.
errors.no_profiles: No listening profiles were found on this account.
